comparison.objective: Candidate mounts a rack rail; record places two setting blocks and lowers a glass unit onto them without touching the sill.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses compliant mechanical latching, telescoping, and fastening; record uses bimanual placement and damage-avoiding descent of a fragile panel into a narrow channel.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained prongs and prescribed screws; record requires marked block placement, glass supported on both blocks, tight centering/tilt limits, release, and no sill contact.
comparison.reason: Long-object support and alignment are generic shared primitives; the record's defining test is fragile supported placement with a never-touch history, not mechanical attachment. Candidate damage and collision thresholds are not quantified.
